title.zh: 将东米萨米斯省卡加延-德奥罗市 Bugo 描笼涯的 Agusan 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Bugo 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Agusan National High School - Bugo Annex in Barangay Bugo, City of Cagayan de Oro, Province of Misamis Oriental from the Agusan National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Bugo National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Agusan National High School - Bugo Annex in Barangay Bugo, City of Cagayan de Oro, Province of Misamis Oriental from the Agusan National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Bugo National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Bugo của Trường Trung học Agusan Quốc gia tại Barangay Bugo, Thành phố Cagayan de Oro, Tỉnh Misamis Oriental khỏi Trường Trung học Agusan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Bugo Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Bugo ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Agusan แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Bugo เมือง Cagayan de Oro จังหวัด Misamis Oriental ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Agusan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bugo แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Bugo, Sekolah Menengah Agusan Nasional di Barangay Bugo, Kota Cagayan de Oro, Provinsi Misamis Oriental dari Sekolah Menengah Agusan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Bugo Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Bugo, Sekolah Menengah Agusan Kebangsaan di Barangay Bugo, Bandar Cagayan de Oro, Wilayah Misamis Oriental daripada Sekolah Menengah Agusan Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Bugo Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Agusan National High School - Bugo Annex in Barangay Bugo, City of Cagayan de Oro, Province of Misamis Oriental is hereby separated from the Agusan National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Bugo National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Agusan National High School - Bugo Annex are here by transferred to and absorbed by the Bugo National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Bugo National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Agusan National High School - Bugo Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
